## Change

Describe the one problem solved, resulting behavior, and why this is the smallest complete change.

## Verification

- Touched callers, validation, authorization and failure behavior inspected:
- Meaningful tests/checks actually run and their results:
- Checks skipped/unavailable and risks:
- Live integrations actually verified (or explicitly none):

## Reviews and merge

- Current head SHA:
- Coding model actually used:
- Ponytail full/upstream revisions read:
- pstack thermo-nuclear-review report and reviewed SHA:
- pstack thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review report and reviewed SHA:
- Findings resolved or justified:
- CI run URL and verified head SHA:

Merge only after both reviews and green CI cover the current commit. New changes require re-review and fresh CI. Merge this focused change before starting the next one. Checklist text is a report of evidence, not an automated approval or authorization.
